VirtualHost configuration:
*:443                  is a NameVirtualHost
         default server shop.example.com (/etc/apache2/sites-enabled/shop.conf:1)
         port 443 namevhost shop.example.com (/etc/apache2/sites-enabled/shop.conf:1)
         port 443 namevhost www.example.com (/etc/apache2/sites-enabled/www.conf:1)
                 alias example.com
                 alias *.cdn.example.com
*:80                   www.example.com (/etc/apache2/sites-enabled/www.conf:9)
ServerRoot: "/etc/apache2"
Main DocumentRoot: "/var/www/html"
Main ErrorLog: "/var/log/apache2/error.log"
Mutex default: dir="/var/run/apache2/" mechanism=default
